text: dsh-workspace-archive-all 是一款 DSH Web 插件，在侧边栏工作区文件夹菜单中加入“全部归档”操作，也支持未分组会话。用户选择后先确认，再逐个归档该分组内符合条件的会话，并看到处理进度和结果。功能会跳过当前正在查看、运行中、空白新会话、子代理及已归档会话，并提供中英文界面文案。它通过为官方工作区客户端提供补丁版 bundle 来扩展侧边栏，适合需要批量整理工作区会话的 DSH Web 用户。安装可使用 DSH 插件 CLI；源码未显示需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-workspace-archive-all adds “Archive All” to DSH Web workspace and Ungrouped menus. After confirmation, it archives eligible sessions one by one with progress feedback. Current, running, blank, subagent, and already archived sessions are skipped. Install with the DSH plugin CLI.
想把某个工作区里的未归档会话一次整理归档。
How can I archive all eligible sessions in a workspace folder at once?
dsh-workspace-archive-all 的功能「批量归档工作区会话」：从侧边栏工作区或未分组菜单启动，确认后逐个归档符合条件的会话，并显示进度和结果；当前会话、运行中、空白、子代理及已归档会话会被跳过。
dsh-workspace-archive-all 的维护与更新元数据：已归档；距最后推送 50 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 22/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · dsh-workspace-archive-all：[中文说明 →](./README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web plugin that adds an
**Archive All** action to every workspace folder menu in the sidebar (the Ungrouped bucket
included) — archiving all unarchived sessions under that folder in one go.

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · dsh-workspace-archive-all：- Confirm dialog → sequential archive with progress → result summary
- Automatically skipped: running sessions, the session you are currently viewing, blank
  provisional "New Session" rows, subagent sessions, and anything already archived
- English and Chinese copy, following the UI language

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · How it works：The sidebar comes from the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` package, whose
client bundle is served by the client module system from the prefix route
`/plugins/<id>/client.js`. This plugin's host half registers an **exact route** for that path
(the webserver matches exact routes before prefixes), serving a patched copy of the bundle:

```
GET /plugins/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace/client.js
  → this plugin's lib/workspace-client.patched.js
```

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · How it works：- No runtime interception, no dependence on script evaluation order
- Uninstalling the plugin removes the route and the stock bundle is served again — the
  official file on disk is never modified
- Response headers mirror the stock bundle server (`text/javascript; charset=utf-8`, `no-cache`)

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · Install：One command with the official CLI (installs the package into the profile and mounts it via
the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` — no manual file edits):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-workspace-archive-all          # from npm (once published)
dsh plugin --profile web add <tarball-url-or-path>              # e.g. the GitHub release .tgz
```

Or as a local bundle without the CLI:

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · Install：1. Put this folder anywhere (e.g. `~/dsh-workspace-archive-all`)
2. Link it into the profile: `ln -s ~/dsh-workspace-archive-all ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-workspace-archive-all`
3. Append `"dsh-workspace-archive-all"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`
4. Restart `dsh web` (the bundle list is read at boot)

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · Install：> The bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` carries a double-mount guard: a manual
> `dsh.profile.bundles` entry makes the package's own insert row stand down, so the two
> channels do not collide — but pick one of them.

Once listed on the [dshmarket](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) marketplace, it can
also be installed with one click from the settings UI.

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-workspace-archive-all
```

Or, for a manual local-bundle install: remove the entry from `dsh.profile.bundles` and
restart; the `dependencies` entry and the symlink can be removed too. Nothing to clean up
inside DSH itself.

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · Upgrading DSH：Re-derive the patched bundle from the new stock file:

```
node tools/build-patch.mjs
```

The stock client path is auto-detected (nvm / Homebrew / `/usr/local` / `PNPM_HOME` / `PATH`);
override with `DSH_STOCK_CLIENT` or `node tools/build-patch.mjs <stock-client.js> [out-file]`.
The 11 find/replace patches each must match exactly once — a clear error means the official
bundle drifted and the pairs need re-deriving.

dsh-workspace-archive-all README · Files：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: registers the exact override route |
| `lib/workspace-client.patched.js` | The patched official workspace client (build artifact) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch: mounts the plugin (with double-mount guard) |
| `tools/build-patch.mjs` | Rebuilds the patched bundle from the stock one |
